cards.front: Can a convergent real sequence have two distinct limits?
cards.back: No. Disjoint sufficiently small neighborhoods around two distinct limits cannot both contain every sufficiently late term of the sequence.
The limit is \(0\). As the positive integer denominator grows without bound, the reciprocal becomes smaller than every positive tolerance.

cards.front: What acceleration does a net force of \(6\,\mathrm{N}\) produce on a constant mass of \(2\,\mathrm{kg}\) in an inertial frame?
cards.back: \(a=F_{net}/m=3\,\mathrm{m/s^2}\), directed along the net force. The relation assumes constant mass and an inertial reference frame.
